title: QMCert: Automated Quality-Control, Stationary Point Certification, and Reproducibility Assessment for Quantum-Chemical Calculations
description: An open-source scientific toolkit for rigorous quality assurance, stationary point certification (0 imaginary frequencies for local minima, exactly 1 for transition states), spin contamination analysis, SCF/geometry convergence auditing, quasi-harmonic thermochemistry corrections, and manuscript-ready reporting for quantum-chemical calculations.
